items.text:
うんこをかくのは恥ずかしいから、友人には控えめに話す。
Study point: The grammar pattern 〜ないものねだり is used here to express hesitation or reluctance in Japanese.
English translation: I hesitate to talk about it with my friend because I don't want to say 'I poop'.
